description: Registro de Aparatos Eléctricos y Electrónicos is a dataset listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Ministerio de Industria y Turismo. Consultas públicas relacionadas con el Registro Integrado Industrial, en lo que se refiere a la información relativa a los productores de aparatos eléctricos y electrónicos. Coverage: Ministerio de Industria y Turismo. The publisher named on the listing is Ministerio de Industria y Turismo. Its keywords include consultas, registros, estadisticas, tecnologia. The listing shows 4 download or service links in HTML. The listing shows 2017-03-14 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://sede.serviciosmin.gob.es/es-ES/Paginas/aviso.aspx#Reutilizacion). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
